events.headline: Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks trigger broad crypto pullback
events.summary: Warsh said inflation remains well above the Fed's 2% target, pushing September rate-hike odds to roughly 56%-62%. Bitcoin fell from an intraday high near $81,300 to about $77,500, a drawdown of roughly 4.7%, while ETH, SOL and XRP also declined. The 24-hour moves remained below the standing market-wide thresholds, but the abrupt macro-driven reversal and repricing of U.S. rates are material for crypto liquidity conditions.

events.headline: Charles Schwab plans direct SOL, AVAX and LINK trading
events.summary: Schwab announced that it will add direct trading in solana, avalanche and chainlink to Schwab Crypto in the coming months, expanding beyond BTC and ETH. SOL rose more than 12% over 24 hours when the announcement and a network tokenomics vote were both in focus.

events.headline: Core Lightning confirms vulnerabilities and urges prompt upgrade
events.summary: Core Lightning confirmed that several AI-generated vulnerability reports identified real flaws. Operators unable to install the forthcoming signed security release are advised to use --offline mode, which disables Lightning payments and routing while preserving blockchain monitoring. No exploitation or fund loss has been reported.
